reasoning: On the season so far the Warriors are the stronger team; with home court the Mavericks start about 4 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 65 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 201 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Golden State are 1-3 without Stephen Curry (oblique), have lost three straight, and Draymond Green and Al Horford are questionable, with ESPN suggesting they may sit one end of the Dallas-Memphis back-to-back. Kristaps Porzingis remains away from the team. Dallas have lost three straight, conceding 127-plus each time, and Dusty May says they are 'looking each other in the mirror'. The angle leans towards Dallas.
